title: Framework-Based Qualitative Analysis of Free Responses of Large Language Models: Algorithmic Fidelity

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing beliefs and attitudes elicited from LLM 'silicon participants' (conditioned with specific sociodemographic backstories of older adults with heart failure) against real human qualitative interview data using the Theoretical Domains Framework to assess algorithmic fidelity.

Observing differences in how male and female 'silicon participants' refer to spouses or partners when describing social influences during simulated interviews (identified as second-order inference bias).
